WITH gaps AS (SELECT 'air-quality' as stream, to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000) as time, EXTRACT(epoch FROM (to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000) - LAG(to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp))) as gap_seconds FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 UNION ALL SELECT 'outdoor-weather', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000), EXTRACT(epoch FROM (to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000) - LAG(to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp))) FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 UNION ALL SELECT 'outdoor-air-quality', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000), EXTRACT(epoch FROM (to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000) - LAG(to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp))) FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 UNION ALL SELECT 'nws-observations', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000), EXTRACT(epoch FROM (to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000) - LAG(to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp))) FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 UNION ALL SELECT 'nws-forecast-hourly', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000), EXTRACT(epoch FROM (to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000) - LAG(to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp))) FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000) SELECT time, stream || ' gap' as stream, gap_seconds/60 as "Gap (minutes)" FROM gaps WHERE gap_seconds > 600 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Completeness Rate (Records per Hour vs Expected)

targets.rawSql: WITH hourly_counts AS (SELECT 'air-quality' as stream, 360 as expected, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as hour, COUNT(*) as actual FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY hour UNION ALL SELECT 'outdoor-weather', 6, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)), COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY hour UNION ALL SELECT 'outdoor-air-quality', 6, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)), COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY hour UNION ALL SELECT 'nws-observations', 12, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)), COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY hour UNION ALL SELECT 'nws-forecast-hourly', 12, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)), COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY hour) SELECT hour as time, stream, (actual::FLOAT / expected * 100) as "Completeness %" FROM hourly_counts ORDER BY hour, stream

WITH all_data AS (SELECT metric, value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 UNION ALL SELECT metric, value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 UNION ALL SELECT metric, value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 UNION ALL SELECT metric, value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 UNION ALL SELECT metric, value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000) SELECT metric, (SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) * 100) as "Null %" FROM all_data GROUP BY metric ORDER BY "Null %" DESC

WITH stream_counts AS (SELECT 'air-quality' as stream, COUNT(*) as count FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 UNION ALL SELECT 'outdoor-weather', COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 UNION ALL SELECT 'outdoor-air-quality', COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 UNION ALL SELECT 'nws-observations', COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 UNION ALL SELECT 'nws-forecast-hourly', COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000) SELECT stream, count as value FROM stream_counts ORDER BY count DESC
